description: Land Title Settlement Department -Ballapana, Udabage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610008
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
